title: A number just added with its step says "Not used yet. Use in f₂"
detail: R06 replay: ⌘K, type z^2 + a, Enter. The palette row promises "Formula, with a new number a = 1" and the toast says "Added f₃ Formula and the number a"; f₃'s own section reads "Numbers: a = 1". But the Inspector's Numbers section under it says "Not used yet." with an offer "Use in f₂" (f₂ is z^2 + 3, which has no a). It stays wrong after clicking other cards and back; only a page reload clears it. A person reads that the number is linked to nothing (exactly UX65's complaint) and is offered to rewrite the wrong step.
evidence: notes/ux-build/shots/w1-review-user/L03-a-added.png; Numbers text before reload 'a = [−2..2] Not used yet. Use in f₂', after reload 'a = [−2..2]' (no line).
fix: Recompute the Numbers usage line from the current chain whenever the chain changes (the palette's step+number add in one undo step does not trigger it); the "Use in" offer should name only a step that could take the number, never when a step already uses it. Add a unit check: add 'z^2 + a' via the palette, the Numbers section has no 'Not used yet'.

title: Near the unit circle the half grid wins: a click just off the circle makes a free grid point
detail: The user's own request: putting a point on the unit circle should be easy. At the default view (52 px per unit, half grid every 26 px) the Point tool clicked 6 px outside the circle at 30° snapped to "grid point 1 + 0.5i" (a free point, not on the circle). Exactly on the stroke it works ("on the unit circle at 30°"). In the opening scene the unit circle in X is only a faint dotted line under the region, so aiming within a few px of it is hard. Also the 15° detents capture about ±5° when placing (5°→1, 25°→30°, 35°→30°), so with Snap on two thirds of the circle can only be reached by sliding or Alt; the hover chip does tell the angle.
evidence: notes/ux-build/shots/w1-review-user/L05-point-hover.png, notes/ux-build/shots/w1-review-user/L05-sheet-place-slide.png; hover chips at 0 px off: 5°→'at 1', 25°→'at 30°', 45°→'Line 1 ∩ the unit circle'; 6 px off at 30°→'grid point 1 + 0.5i'.
fix: Rank curve targets above grid points when the pointer is within the curve's capture band (grid points only when no curve is within ~8 px, or when the grid point also lies on that curve); keep the detents for sliding but make the placement detent narrower (±2°). Consider drawing the shown unit circle a little stronger while a point/construct tool is armed.

title: After an Orthogonal circle on the phone, X's pattern refits and Y's inset zooms out, without a word
detail: Orthogonal on the shown unit circle with two taps on it works (3 taps after arming, circle orthogonal and through both points; the user's "needs distinct points" bug is gone on laptop and phone). But the moment the circle is made, X's checker cells double and turn pale, and the Y inset re-fits to the new circle's large image so the region's image shrinks to a blob in the corner. No message showed (UX91's once-per-session toast was already used earlier in the tab). The person sees their picture change because they drew a construction line.
fix: Do not refit the pattern cell or Y's view for construction curves (circles/lines from Construct are not regions); at most refit for regions, and keep UX91's note per change, not per session.

device: phone 412x860, Russian (and English with a sheet open)
title: The X chip's "Hold and slide to read F(z)" is cut; in Russian the key words are lost
detail: UX10's teaching line lives in X's scale chip. In Russian at 412 px it reads «2 / дел. Удерживайте и ведите палец, чтобы …»: «прочитать F(z)», the point of the hint, is cut. In English it fits at full height, but with the More tools sheet open (split view) it reads 'Hold and slid…'.
fix: A shorter Russian line that fits (e.g. «Удерживайте палец — F(z)») or let the hint drop to a second line / drop to an icon + 'F(z)' when the chip is narrow; never ellipsize it.

title: The Inspector's "+ Number" floats far below its section
detail: In the Numbers section the "+ Number" button sits 100–150 px below the hint or the last number, with empty space between (more when the tour's first-run line takes its 48 px). It reads as belonging to nothing.
evidence: notes/ux-build/shots/w1-review-user/L02-pub-first.png (hint at y≈345, button at y≈492), notes/ux-build/shots/w1-review-user/L03-a-added.png (button at y≈594)
fix: Place + Number directly under the last number or the hint (no flex push to the panel's bottom).

title: Orthogonal's prompt for the second pick does not say a tap on the circle is fine
detail: After picking the circle, the chip says "Pick a point or an empty spot · 1 of 2 · Orthogonal". The user's case is two points ON that circle; the words suggest the circle itself is not a valid place and a tap on it might re-pick the curve. It works, but a person has to try it. The chip also offers 'Whole | Inside | Outside' with no word of what they do.
fix: "Pick a point (on Circle 1 or anywhere)"; a tooltip/aria for Whole/Inside/Outside (e.g. 'Draw the whole circle / only inside / only outside Circle 1').
